question: Vilasini Natyam, once performed in temples and royal courts, is a classical dance revived in which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vilasini Natyam** is a traditional classical dance form that was historically performed in **temples** and **royal courts** of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• This dance was practiced by **Devadasis** (female temple dancers) as a form of worship in temples and as a performance art in royal courts. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• It was revived by modern practitioners after facing a decline during the **colonial period** when the practice of Devadasis was abolished under social reform movements. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• The revival of Vilasini Natyam is credited to **Padma Shri Swapnasundari**, a renowned dancer who worked extensively to restore and preserve this art form. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
